title: enforce_db_limit has maximum nesting depth 5, exceeding threshold of 4
detail: lizard reports nesting=5 (threshold 4) in enforce_db_limit (lines 148-195, 48 lines). The 5-level nesting makes the conditional logic hard to follow. Refactor the innermost nested block into a named helper function to flatten the structure.

title: Public function get_legacy_default_limits lacks a docstring
detail: get_legacy_default_limits is a public function with no docstring; callers cannot determine the structure of the returned dict or any caching behaviour from the signature alone. Add a one-line docstring describing the returned mapping.
